text:
dan: heads-up: onboarding for tenant `aurora` started failing. SSO exchange returns audience mismatch and subsequent SCIM creates hit rate-limit errors. also seeing intermittent KMS unwrap errors. anyone familiar with this combo?

meera: can you paste the minimal errors? is the audience mismatch from our SP or the IdP?

dan: logs (staging):
```
2024-08-14T02:22:01Z saml-proxy ERROR tenant=aurora POST /sso/acs 400 {"detail":"invalid audience: https://api.aurora-apps/ not in assertion"}
2024-08-14T02:22:02Z scim-provisioner WARN tenant=aurora POST /scim/v2/Users 429 {"detail":"rate limit exceeded"}
2024-08-14T02:22:03Z kms-client ERROR tenant=aurora unwrap: ambiguous alias: multiple keys match alias pattern
```

owen: ambiguous alias is new to me. infra changed KMS policy to allow alias globbing for team migration; could result in two keys matching `alias/aurora-*`. KMS unwrap might pick wrong key leading to decrypt failures.

meera: audience mismatch: IdP is sending assertion with audience set to the app host instead of our proxy endpoint. we've got two possible fixes: 1) update our SP metadata to include the app host in accepted audiences for backward compat; 2) ask IdP to change produced audience to our ACS URL. For now we should prefer (1) to reduce breakage during tenant rollout.

dan: SCIM rate limits: onboarding retries are aggressive and hammer our SCIM tier after several failed SSO handoffs. we should switch onboarding to exponential backoff and honor Retry-After. also throttle per-tenant in the provisioner.

audit-bot: [audit] saml-audience-mismatch tenant=aurora events=12 window=10m

owen: proposed action list:
- immediately update SP audience whitelist for aurora to include `https://app.aurora-apps/` (short-lived allowlist)
- rollback KMS alias globbing policy to explicit aliases for aurora until migration completes
- add per-tenant SCIM rate limiter and exponential retry with jitter
- capture full assertion headers (redacted) in audit logs when audience fails so we can share with IdP

meera: caution on logging: redact PII and only keep assertion metadata (issuer, audience, cert thumbprint). file CR for audit retention change if needed.

dan: i'll PR the temporary audience whitelist and per-tenant throttle. owen, can you coordinate infra rollback for KMS alias policy?

owen: starting rollback now. also will run a quick KMS scan to find envelopes encrypted with non-explicit aliases and tag them for rewrap.

audit-bot: [audit] scim-rate-limits_detected tenant=aurora spikes=4 last_hour=1
meera: follow-ups: 1) RFC to stop accepting audience variants and make IdP update mandatory within 30 days; 2) migrate RBAC mapping away from displayName to stable externalId/email for aurora (they use displayName changes frequently); 3) add vulnerability note: ambiguous KMS aliasing can lead to silent decrypt failures and must be forbidden by policy.

dan: staging: after audience whitelist and throttle patch, onboarding attempts succeed and rate of KMS errors falls to zero. will schedule prod deploy in the 02:00 UTC window and draft an incident summary.

owen: infra rollback applied; KMS scan found 3 envelopes with ambiguous alias tag, scheduling rewrap jobs. tagging owners in the KMS migration runbook.

dan: thanks team. i'll post the postmortem here once prod run completes.
